column1: This disturbance will reflect variations in income or other factors that produce fluctuations in deposit demand. One interpretation of (11.25) is that it represents a relationship between the innovations in total reserve demand and the funds rate after the lagged e¤ects of all other factors have been removed. For example, Bernanke and Mihov (1998) attempted to identify policy shocks by focusing on the relationships among the innovations to reserve demand, reserve supply, and the funds rate obtained as the residuals from a VAR model of reserve market variables. They characterized alternative operating procedures in terms of the parameters linking these innovations.
